chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim narrated from Abd al-Rahman from Alaa from Muhammad ibn Muslim from one of the Imams (peace be upon them both) who said:
I asked him about a man who performed the obligatory circumambulation (Tawaf) eight times. He said: 'He adds six [circumambulations] to them.'
ai.seo_question: How many rounds of Tawaf are required after performing eight obligatory rounds?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the procedure for completing the Tawaf when a worshipper mistakenly performs eight rounds instead of the standard seven. The ruling indicates that the individual must add six additional rounds to the existing eight, totaling fourteen, thereby ensuring the validity of the ritual through this specific method of completion. This highlights the Shia jurisprudential approach to correcting ritual errors while maintaining the integrity of the pilgrimage rites.
